article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Balanced hybrid
Genetics: Bruce Banner #3 × SFV OG IBL
Breeder: The Cali Connection
THC Content: 20–30%
CBD Content: Usually very low
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , terpinolene, ocimene
Primary Flavors: Strawberry, lemon, sweet berries, diesel
Flowering Time (Indoor): 63–68 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: early to mid-October
Indoor Yield: Medium to large
Outdoor Yield: Medium to large
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Strawberry OG is built around a difficult breeding target: keeping the unmistakable power and structure of OG-influenced marijuana while making ripe strawberry and sharp lemon flavors strong enough to survive alongside the fuel. The Cali Connection pursued that combination using Colorado’s Bruce Banner #3 and its own worked SFV OG material, ultimately producing a fast-finishing feminized hybrid with the frame of Bruce Banner and a flavor the breeder compares to strawberry-lemon pie and strawberry lemonade. The official catalog currently lists the genetics as Bruce Banner #3 × SFV OG IBL, a 63–68 day flowering period, and medium-to-large production.

Unlike hybrids whose fruit character disappears beneath generic sweetness, good Strawberry OG flower retains a distinctly tart edge. Fresh berries and citrus sit over diesel, earth, and OG Kush-style pine, creating an aroma that moves between fruit stand and fuel rather than settling into either category. The effects show a similar contrast: an initially buoyant cerebral character can gradually become more physically relaxed without necessarily turning immediately sedating.
Genetics and Lineage

The Cali Connection identifies Strawberry OG’s current genetic formula as Bruce Banner #3 × SFV OG IBL. The breeder’s more detailed history explains that Bruce Banner #3 was first crossed into SFV OG Kush F4 material, followed by a selection process focused on plants showing strong strawberry flavor and an OG-like appearance. Tahoe OG Kush S1 genetics were subsequently incorporated during development of the feminized version. This history explains why simplified descriptions encountered elsewhere do not always match one another exactly.

Bruce Banner #3 brings substantial potency, vigorous hybrid growth, resin production, and the strawberry-fuel qualities inherited through its own Strawberry Diesel ancestry. Its other major genetic influence, OG Kush , reinforces gas, lemon, earth, and physical depth. The SFV OG side intensifies that Southern California Kush character while contributing the sharp citrus and fuel notes that prevent the finished cultivar from tasting like straightforward berry weed.

The breeding goal was therefore more specific than simply crossing two famous names. The Cali Connection selected toward strawberry-forward plants while retaining Bruce Banner’s productive architecture and the recognizable structure of an OG hybrid. The breeder currently describes the result as having a Bruce Banner frame paired with a highly competitive terpene profile reminiscent of strawberry lemonade.
Effects and Experience

Strawberry OG generally enters through the cerebral side first. The early stage can feel upbeat, mentally expansive, and socially comfortable, with an increase in interest rather than an abrupt feeling of heaviness. Creative activities, music, conversation, and relaxed daytime recreation may fit this portion of the experience especially well. Stronger batches can create a noticeably more intense rush, so the seemingly friendly fruit profile should not be mistaken for low potency.

Physical effects tend to build more gradually. As the initial euphoria settles, a warmer relaxation can spread through the body without completely shutting down mental activity. That balance separates the cultivar from more sedating OG Kush descendants: the body may become comfortable while the mind remains interested in whatever is happening. Larger doses are more likely to slow the experience considerably and may reduce the functional quality that appears at moderate amounts.

Modern potency varies dramatically between farms. A 2025 laboratory certificate for flower sold as Strawberry OG measured 33.81% total THC with CBD not detected, demonstrating the upper end that some commercial batches can reach. Other regulated examples have tested substantially lower, so one number should never be treated as a permanent property of the genetics. Consumers should evaluate the actual product label and adjust dosage accordingly.
Medical Benefits

The combination of mental elevation and developing physical relaxation may appeal to some medical marijuana consumers who prefer a hybrid that does not begin with immediate sedation. A lower dose may feel relatively engaging, while increased consumption tends to emphasize the relaxing side of the experience. That progression can be useful for people who prefer cannabis whose character changes gradually rather than moving straight into a heavy body stone.

Potency is an important consideration for medical use. Flower above 25% THC may be considerably stronger than necessary for many consumers, and high doses can increase dizziness, anxiety, cognitive impairment, or rapid heart rate in susceptible individuals. Someone responding well to a moderate Strawberry OG batch may therefore have a very different experience with flower testing above 30%.

No clinical evidence establishes Strawberry OG itself as a treatment for pain, anxiety, depression, insomnia, or another condition. Medical cannabis decisions should be based on the chemistry of the particular product, dose, personal response, other medications, and appropriate professional guidance rather than strain reputation alone.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The breeder’s clearest description is strawberry-lemon pie or strawberry lemonade. That combination captures the brighter portion of the profile well: ripe strawberry sweetness is joined by tart lemon peel rather than becoming syrupy or candy-like. Once a flower is broken apart, the OG background becomes more obvious through diesel, damp earth, herbs, and pine.

Laboratory data also shows that Strawberry OG does not have one fixed terpene formula. A regulated flower analysis recorded beta-myrcene at approximately 0.68%, terpinolene at 0.676%, beta-ocimene at 0.453%, trans-caryophyllene at 0.235%, and beta-pinene at 0.108%. Another commercial data set has shown a very different balance, illustrating how phenotype, cultivation environment, harvest timing, and curing can alter the aromatic chemistry.

On the palate, strawberry usually appears most clearly at the beginning. Lemon and other bright citrus flavors sharpen the sweetness before diesel, pine, pepper, and earthy OG characteristics take over toward the finish. Properly cured flower preserves the fruit-gas contrast; overdried buds can lose much of the volatile strawberry and citrus character and taste considerably more generic.
Growing Information

The Cali Connection gives Strawberry OG a 63–68 day flowering window, placing it at approximately nine to ten weeks indoors. Yield is officially rated medium to large. The breeder describes the plant as retaining a Bruce Banner-style structure while benefiting from the production of its worked SFV OG genetics and the comparatively quick finishing qualities introduced during the breeding program.

Vegetative growth can produce enough branching to support a broad canopy, making early topping and lateral training useful where space permits. Once flowering begins, branches carrying large terminal buds may eventually need support. Strategic pruning underneath the canopy can redirect energy toward well-lit sites while maintaining enough foliage to support vigorous flower development.

Resin production becomes increasingly obvious late in bloom, and mature flowers can become dense enough that airflow deserves close attention. Outdoors, the breeder does not publish a universal harvest date, but a 63–68 day flowering cycle commonly puts plants somewhere around early to mid-October in suitable Northern Hemisphere climates. Local latitude, weather, and the actual onset of flowering determine the real schedule, making trichome and flower maturity better harvest indicators than a fixed calendar date.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Strawberry OG?

The Cali Connection currently lists Strawberry OG as Bruce Banner #3 × SFV OG IBL. Its detailed breeding description also explains that selected SFV OG material and Tahoe OG Kush S1 played roles during development of the feminized line.
Is Strawberry OG indica or sativa?

It is best treated as a balanced to sativa-leaning hybrid rather than assigned an exact percentage. Bruce Banner #3 can contribute a brighter cerebral character, while the OG side adds substantial physical relaxation.
How strong is Strawberry OG?

Potency varies substantially. Modern flower often falls somewhere in the 20% THC range, while exceptional laboratory-tested batches have exceeded 30%. One 2025 flower sample measured 33.81% total THC.
What does Strawberry OG taste like?

Strawberry, lemon, and sweet berries form the brighter side of the profile, followed by diesel, earth, pine, herbs, and mild pepper. The Cali Connection specifically compares its flavor with strawberry-lemon pie and strawberry lemonade.
How long does Strawberry OG take to flower?
The breeder specifies 63–68 days indoors, or roughly nine to ten weeks. Yield is officially rated medium to large.
Final Thoughts on Strawberry OG

Strawberry OG succeeds because its fruit character was selected rather than simply implied by a name. The Cali Connection worked Bruce Banner #3 with its SFV OG material and searched specifically for plants capable of pairing recognizable strawberry flavor with an OG-style structure. The current feminized line retains that objective, combining a medium-to-large yield with a relatively quick 63–68 day flowering cycle and a breeder-described strawberry lemonade terpene profile.

What reaches the jar is more complex than sweet berry marijuana. Strawberry and lemon dominate the first impression, yet diesel, pine, earth, and pepper connect this weed strain unmistakably with its OG heritage. The high follows the same pattern of contrast, moving from brighter cerebral euphoria toward more substantial physical relaxation as the session progresses. With modern examples capable of reaching very high THC levels, Strawberry OG has enough potency to compete with newer exotic hybrids while retaining the fruit-and-fuel personality that originally made the breeding project distinctive.
